ctx.x: I went and played with one of them rock bands, once. I won't go play with them. No use for me to go play, I don't know what I'm playing. I played with one one night, the business agent begged me to go, as they had had -- to have a bass player, say, please go, do that favor for me. I say, you know I don't like to play with them guys. I said, this me going to play one key, and it's just running the scale maybe in C or G, that's all they do bab-bab-bab-ab- -- bah. So I got up there on the bandstand and they knocked…
I said, now ain't this awful. I know all I was running the scale like the tenor saxophone was making, bum-bum-bum -- I said bum-bum-bum- --take another one, Tudie. Toetie.
